description: This PHP class defines a URI scheme handler for 'tel' links, primarily used for validating and normalizing telephone numbers within web applications. It simplifies phone number formats by allowing only a leading plus sign, digits, and 'x' characters for extensions, conforming to RFC 3966 and RFC 5341 standards.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_tel
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_URIScheme to validate and normalize 'tel' URI schemes for phone numbers.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the 'tel' URI, stripping out invalid characters while preserving an optional leading plus sign and extension characters.
